verification_loop_job.definition: A bounded repair or build-verify loop that iterates builder and verifier work until a proof-bearing stop condition is reached.

fanout_job.definition: A coordinating job that launches multiple child jobs or workers from one parent objective while keeping write scope and evidence policy bounded.

campaign_job.definition: A multi-phase program or campaign coordinator that sequences related jobs over time under one durable campaign identity.

experiment_run_job.definition: A job whose primary purpose is to launch and track an experiment run under the canonical experiment contract and run lifecycle truth.

delegation_tree_job.definition: A future recursive job shape for durable delegation trees where child jobs can themselves become managed parents under the same contract family.
